parameters.query:
SELECT id, user_id, max_user_id, last_chat_id, current_step
FROM bot_sessions
WHERE id = {{ $json.session_id }}
LIMIT 1

SELECT id AS log_id, message_id
FROM bot_messages_log
WHERE session_id = {{ $('OH: CODE Global Config').item.json.session_id }}
  AND is_active = true
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 1

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO bot_messages_log (session_id, max_user_id, chat_id, message_id, step, has_keyboard, is_active)
VALUES (
  {{ $('OH: CODE Prep step').item.json.session_id }},
  {{ $('OH: CODE Prep step').item.json.max_user_id }},
  '{{ $('OH: CODE Prep step').item.json.chat_id }}',
  '{{ $json.message?.body?.mid || $json.message?.message_id || $json.message?.id }}',
  '{{ $('OH: CODE Prep step').item.json.next_step }}',
  {{ $('OH: CODE Prep step').item.json.has_keyboard }},
  {{ $('OH: CODE Prep step').item.json.has_keyboard }}
)
RETURNING id, message_id

UPDATE bot_sessions
SET
  last_bot_message_id = $1,
  current_step        = $2,
  updated_at          = NOW(),
  expires_at          = NOW() + INTERVAL '24 hours'
WHERE id = $3

UPDATE bot_sessions
SET context = COALESCE(context, '{}'::jsonb) || $1::jsonb,
    updated_at = NOW(),
    expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '24 hours'
WHERE id = $2;
